name: MEAN WELL NDR-240 power supply
summary: DIN-rail power-supply family with 24 V and 48 V output selections.
description: Coordinate the metal enclosure, rail engagement and terminals with nearby wire duct. Allow access to the adjustment and indication faces and use installation guidance to determine cooling space.
The GA illustration is independently authored conceptual geometry, without dimensions or scale. Refer to the manufacturer STEP and selected product instructions for the actual mounting envelope.
readingNotes: The official resource groups NDR-240-24 and NDR-240-48 with an NDR-240 3D archive.
The NDR and SDR product families are separate selections even where their layout role is similar.
drawingChecklist: Record the complete output-voltage order code.
Check the selected CAD configuration, terminal access and rail attachment.
Apply manufacturer installation spacing and reserve cable bend and replacement space.
distinction: The NDR and SDR product families are separate selections even where their layout role is similar.
